Which booking site listed the lowest prices for Tacoma hotels?

The study's count, before taxes and fees: in the September 30, 2026 snapshot, at 11 of the 16 Tacoma hotels with a price, the lowest-priced listing was 5% or more below the going rate. Sites with the lowest price there: Super.com at 2, trivago DEALS at 2, Vio.com at 2, Agoda at 1, Billabook.com at 1, dealbase.com at 1, Silver Cloud Hotel- Tacoma Waterfront at 1 and Traveluro at 1. These are the Tacoma rows of the study's per-hotel CSV (going_rate_usd and cheapest_usd, before taxes and fees).

On this page, all-in: with taxes and fees as the sites reported them (a resort or destination fee may be extra), at 10 of the 15 hotels listed below a site was 5% or more below the all-in going rate. Sites with the lowest price there: Etrip.net at 3, Vio.com at 3, Super.com at 2, trivago DEALS at 2, Billabook.com at 1, dealbase.com at 1, Silver Cloud Hotel- Tacoma Waterfront at 1, Traveluro at 1 and 1 other site at 1 between them (a tie counts for each site). At the other 5, no site was 5% or more below it. The two counts differ: the study also counts the 1 named below that are not listed on this page. Each hotel below shows every site's all-in price. Taxes and fees at Tacoma hotels

At the 12 hotels with both an all-in and a before-tax going rate, taxes and fees, as the booking sites reported them to Google Hotels, added a median of 15% ($17 a night) to the before-tax going rate: from 14% at Best Western Plus Tacoma Hotel to 15% at La Quinta Inn & Suites by Wyndham Tacoma - Seattle. At 3 hotels no site reported a before-tax price, so their prices are listed prices that may leave out resort or property fees. Our data does not split the gap into taxes and fees.
